criterion: Capacity evidence is explicit and traceable
why_it_matters: Store capacity strongly affects feasible shifting and flexibility value
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states source basis units and store class
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms the capacity evidence is traceable and limited appropriately
fail_or_defer_condition: If capacity is inferred indirectly or without traceability then defer
notes: Store capacities are not safe to promote from narrative support alone.

why_it_matters: Large buffers can create false economic value if overstated
required_evidence_or_check: Check that the packet flags flexibility-value risk and sensitivity need
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms sensitivity treatment or defers promotion
fail_or_defer_condition: If a high-impact capacity is proposed as unconditional truth then fail
notes: Store capacities are a late-review category for this reason.

criterion: Endpoint policy review does not imply capacity approval
why_it_matters: CYC50 and similar endpoint rules are not capacity evidence
required_evidence_or_check: Check that policy and capacity are separated in the packet
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms no capacity is implied by endpoint logic
fail_or_defer_condition: If capacity is justified only by endpoint-policy language then fail
notes: This protects against silent buffer-capacity approval.
